claims.claim: Nvidia said final Vera Rubin specifications reflect what the system sustains at qualified volume production, replacing preliminary architectural targets.
claims.episode_span: specifications published during Vera Rubin’s development were preliminary architectural targets
claims.source_title: NVIDIA’s Official Statement on Vera Rubin Spec Change
claims.supporting_quote: The specifications published during Vera Rubin’s development were preliminary architectural targets. Final specifications on nvidia.com and the Vera Rubin datasheet reflect what the system sustains at qualified, volume production.

claims.claim: Production HBM4 bandwidth is listed at 19.2 TB/s versus 22 TB/s at unveiling, a 12.7 percent reduction, and NVLink bandwidth at 3 TB/s versus 3.6 TB/s, a 16.7 percent reduction, on NVL72 and NVL8.
claims.episode_span: HBM4 bandwidth on that sheet is 19.2 terabytes per second, against 22 terabytes per second
claims.source_title: NVIDIA’s Official Statement on Vera Rubin Spec Change
claims.supporting_quote: In the latest spec sheet, NVIDIA now shows the HBM4 bandwidth reduced to 19.2 TB/s while the NVLink bandwidth is reduced to 3 TB/s. This is a 12.7% lower HBM4 and 16.7% lower NVLINK-6 bandwidth figure.

claims.claim: At unveiling, each Rubin GPU was advertised with 288 GB of HBM4.
claims.episode_span: Each Rubin GPU had been shown with 288 gigabytes of HBM4.
claims.source_title: NVIDIA’s Official Statement on Vera Rubin Spec Change
claims.supporting_quote: When NVIDIA initially unveiled its Vera Rubin platform during GTC 2026 earlier this year, each Rubin GPU was advertised with 288 GB of HBM4 memory and 22 TB/s of bandwidth, alongside 3.6 TB/s of NVLink 6 bandwidth.

claims.claim: Nvidia said Vera Rubin NVL72 is in full production and shipping, and that third-party benchmarks on production specs show 30 times the performance per watt and 30 times the tokens per dollar versus GB300 NVL72.
claims.episode_span: Vera Rubin NVL72 is in full production and shipping
claims.source_title: NVIDIA’s Official Statement on Vera Rubin Spec Change
claims.supporting_quote: Vera Rubin NVL72 is in full production and shipping today. Third-party agentic benchmarks have been available for months with outstanding performance measured using production specifications - 30x more performance per watt and 30x more tokens per dollar versus the previous-generation GB300 NVL72.

claims.claim: Nvidia and AMD are investing a combined $4 billion in Meta, $3 billion from Nvidia and $1 billion from AMD, alongside a Meta plan to raise $97.5 billion in equity.
claims.episode_span: Nvidia and AMD are investing a combined $4 billion in Meta
claims.source_title: Nvidia, AMD Commit $4B to Meta AI Buildout
claims.supporting_quote: Meta disclosed Monday, Oct. 26, that it plans to raise $97.5 billion through an equity offering to support its continued investment in AI infrastructure. Nvidia announced a $3 billion investment the same day, and AMD followed Tuesday with a $1 billion commitment.

claims.claim: Meta plans to deploy Vera Rubin, Vera CPUs, Spectrum-X Ethernet, and BlueField-4, and AMD said Helios racks are installed and being tested at Meta.
claims.episode_span: initial Helios rack-scale systems have been installed and are being tested by Meta
claims.source_title: Nvidia, AMD Commit $4B to Meta AI Buildout
claims.supporting_quote: The chipmaker said initial AMD Helios rack-scale systems have been installed and are being tested by Meta ahead of a broader deployment.

claims.claim: DigiTimes reported TSMC A14 risk production in the second half of 2027 and mass production in the first half of 2028 at Fab 20 and Fab 25, with 2028 A14 capacity 7.5 times Intel 14A.
claims.episode_span: A14 node is set for risk production in the second half of 2027 and mass production in the first half of 2028
claims.source_title: TSMC To Commence A14 Process Node Mass Production in the First Half of 2028
claims.supporting_quote: In a report by DigiTimes, it is stated that TSMC's A14 process node will enter mass production in the first half of 2028. This will be a follow-up to the risk production, which is planned for the 2nd half of 2027.

claims.claim: Wccftech reports A14 offers 15 percent higher speed at the same power, up to 30 percent power-efficiency improvement, and up to 20 percent density versus N2.
claims.episode_span: 15 percent higher speed at the same power, up to 30 percent better power efficiency, and up to 20 percent density versus N2
claims.source_title: TSMC To Commence A14 Process Node Mass Production in the First Half of 2028
claims.supporting_quote: TSMC's A14 process node will bring in 15% higher speed at the exact power consumption figures, which means you are looking at up to 30% power-efficiency improvements.

claims.claim: AUO approved sale of Taichung Plant Phase II to TSMC for NT$38.8 billion excluding taxes, and terminated a NT$19.7 billion Huaya sale to Quanta.
claims.episode_span: sale of its Taichung Plant Phase II facilities and related infrastructure to TSMC for NT$38.8 billion
claims.source_title: AUO sells Taichung plant to TSMC for NT$38.8B, scraps Quanta deal
claims.supporting_quote: AUO has approved the sale of its Taichung Plant Phase II facilities and related infrastructure to TSMC for NT$38.8 billion (US$1.2 billion), excluding taxes, and has terminated a planned NT$19.7 billion sale of its Huaya facilities to Quanta

claims.claim: The Taichung site covers a Gen 5 and a Gen 7.5 fab on about 428,000 square metres, with an estimated disposal gain of about NT$18.5 billion.
claims.episode_span: estimated disposal gain of about NT$18.5 billion, or about $568.7 million
claims.source_title: Taiwan's AUO Posts Q3 Operating Loss of NT$0.33 Per Share; Sells Taichung Phase 2 Plant to TSMC
claims.supporting_quote: The site covers a Gen 5 and a Gen 7.5 fab, with a registered area of roughly 129,700 ping (approximately 428,000 square meters). The total transaction value is NT$38.8 billion (approximately $1.2 billion), with an estimated disposal gain of about NT$18.5 billion (approximately $568.7 million).
